fields.name: Classic Margherita Pizza
fields.instructions: 1. Prepare pizza dough using Flour. 2. Spread Tomato sauce evenly over the dough. 3. Top with fresh Cheese. 4. Bake at 450°F (230°C) for 10-15 minutes until crust is golden.

fields.name: Quick Chicken Stir Fry
fields.description: A healthy and fast weeknight meal.
fields.instructions: 1. Cut Chicken Breast into bite-sized pieces. 2. Mince the Garlic. 3. Chop Broccoli florets. 4. Heat oil in a wok or large pan. 5. Stir fry chicken until cooked through. 6. Add garlic and broccoli, cooking until broccoli is tender-crisp. 7. Serve immediately.
